_comment: Git and Git LFS shipped inside the Windows installer. installer/build.ps1 downloads each file, refuses it unless the SHA-256 matches, and assembles the bundle. MinGit already contains Git Credential Manager (the version Git for Windows tests with that Git), so GCM is not downloaded separately. To update: change version, url and sha256 together (each GitHub release lists the sha256), rebuild, and see 'The installer includes Git' in README.md.
